facts.text: The resort is set on 22 acres on a peninsula in Punta de Mita, overlooking the Pacific Ocean.
facts.excerpt: redefines beachfront luxury on a serene peninsula in Punta de Mita, Mexico. Set amidst 22 lush acres overlooking the Pacific Ocean

facts.text: The resort showcases Mexican art and handcrafted furnishings, with design rooted in the spirit of Riviera Nayarit.
facts.excerpt: this Punta Mita Resort showcases Mexican art, handcrafted furnishings, and an immersive design experience rooted in the spirit of Riviera Nayarit

facts.text: Rooms and suites are decorated with artworks from local workshops and include butler service in every category.
facts.excerpt: adorned with exclusive artworks from local workshops, infused with the essence of hacienda living, and featuring personalized signature butler service across all categories

facts.text: Each beachfront villa has a private pool and a fully equipped kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Each villa features a private pool, fully equipped kitchen, and spacious living areas

facts.text: The three-bedroom Presidential Villa has a private pool, multiple terraces and views of the Marietas Islands.
facts.excerpt: Outdoors, the villa features a private pool, multiple terraces with lounging and dining spaces, and breathtaking views of the Marietas Island.

facts.text: Room interiors have exposed wood-beam ceilings, terra-cotta floors and artisan-crafted tapestries.
facts.excerpt: Exposed wood-beam ceilings, terra-cotta floors, and artisan-crafted tapestries give the spaces a hacienda-by-the-sea feeling.

facts.text: The resort first opened in 2008 and received a comprehensive refresh in 2023 led by Bibiana Huber of B-Huber architecture studio in Guadalajara.
facts.excerpt: First opened in 2008, St. Regis received a comprehensive $45 million refresh in 2023, led by Bibiana Huber of B-Huber architecture studio, based in Guadalajara, Jalisco.

facts.text: Sakana is an adults-only restaurant and pool area serving Nikkei flavors, including sushi, sashimi and poke bowls.
facts.excerpt: Our Adult-Only restaurant and pool area, perfect for beachfront dining in Punta de Mita, refreshes with Nikkei flavors—offering sushi, sashimi, poke bowls, and the best Nikkei mixology.

facts.text: Mita Mary serves seafood made with Pacific coastal ingredients, grilled on the beach.
facts.excerpt: Curated with Pacific Coastal ingredients, the renovated Mita Mary offers an originally-sourced seafood selection, with grilled techniques on the beach.

facts.text: Carolina is named for New York socialite Caroline Astor and offers a seasonal 10-course tasting menu.
facts.excerpt: head to Carolina, named for New York socialite Caroline Astor. The seasonal 10-course tasting is not to be missed

facts.text: The resort's own Bloody Mary, the Mita Mary, is made with white tequila and other local ingredients.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Punta Mita created the “Mita Mary” prepared with white tequila instead, and other local ingredients.

facts.text: A champagne sabering ceremony marks the transition from day to night at sunset every day.
facts.excerpt: Guests gather for a ceremonial champagne sabering to celebrate the transition from the day into night. Experience the St. Regis tradition at sunset everyday

facts.text: Every Friday at Sea Breeze Beach, guests can choose their catch of the day from local fishermen with the Executive Chef.
facts.excerpt: Local fishermen deliver the bay’s freshest fish and guests may select the day’s lunch or dinner directly with our Executive Chef.

facts.text: The spa offers a Temazcal experience drawing on Huichol tradition.
facts.excerpt: Elevating Huichol tradition with transformative healing; awaits the Temazcal experience of a lifetime.

facts.text: The spa's Couples' Retreat Cabin has a heated pool and a private lounge area.
facts.excerpt: Couples' Retreat Cabin: Exclusively designed to provide a serene sanctuary for our esteemed guests, featuring a tranquil heated pool and a private lounge area

facts.text: Guests can play a 36-hole Jack Nicklaus golf course framed by the Pacific Ocean and Banderas Bay.
facts.excerpt: Spectacular 36-hole course framed by the Pacific Ocean and Banderas Bay. Our Punta Mita golf resort is available for Guest Only.

facts.text: The St. Regis Family Traditions kids' club is complimentary and includes a welcome kit with sand toys, cooking classes and movies with snacks.
facts.excerpt: Welcome kit with sand toys, also available are plush toys for special celebrations, cooking classes, and movies with snacks.

facts.text: Families have a children's club and a tiered infinity pool, with a separate adults-only pool on the other side of the resort.
facts.excerpt: The hotel caters well to families, with an expansive children’s club and tiered infinity pool to keep little ones entertained. (A separate adults-only pool is on the other side of the resort.)

facts.text: The resort is about 45 minutes from Puerto Vallarta International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Just 45 minutes from Puerto Vallarta International Airport, nestled on the Punta Mita peninsula

facts.text: The resort is inside a 1,500-acre enclave, shared with neighboring hotels and residences, that has more than nine miles of private beach.
facts.excerpt: St. Regis (along with several neighboring luxury hotels and residences in Punta Mita) is on a 1,500-acre lush enclave with more than nine miles of private beach and two golf courses from Jack Nicklaus.

facts.text: Guests can call for a complimentary golf cart service around the resort.
facts.excerpt: the property has gently sloping ramps, and guests can call for a complimentary golf cart service.

facts.text: Some casitas have steps at the entryway, so guests needing step-free access should say so when booking.
facts.excerpt: Some casitas have steps at the entryway, so note if you need step-free access at the time of booking.

facts.text: Pets are welcome, one per room, for a non-refundable fee.
facts.excerpt: Yes, pets are welcome at The St. Regis Punta Mita Resort. One pet is allowed per room, with a maximum weight of 25.0 kgs.

facts.text: Kayaking and surfing are among the resort's activities.
facts.excerpt:
### Kayaking

### Surfing

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

contradictions.note: p1 copy says three pools, while p1 and p5 amenity listings show two (Las Marietas family pool and Sakana adult pool)
p4 intro says Carolina showcases modern Mexican cuisine, while p4 listing classes it as a Steakhouse

sources.excerpt: Our signature restaurant, Carolina, showcases the very best of modern Mexican cuisine.
